correctness.rationale: For stationary linear two-coordinate Langevin system dX=(Q−X)dt+sqrt(2)dW, dQ=g(X−Q)dt+sqrt(2g)dB with independent Poisson rate-r resetting only X to 0, generator equations yield exactly U=2(g+r+1)/(r(g+r+2)), V=(2g+r+2)/(r(g+r+2)) and Z=(r+2)(g+r+1)/(r(g+r+2)). Constant-rate pre-reset Palm sampling gives the same U,V. Matrix exponential e^{Mt} at Exp(r) waiting times gives event-chain regressions E[Y_{j+1}|Q_j]=bQ_j, E[Q_{j+1}|Q_j]=aQ_j with b=1/(r+g+1), a=(r+1)/(r+g+1). Iteration gives Corr(Y_j,Y_{j+m})=ba^(m−1)V/U, exactly the displayed positive geometric expression. Its r-log derivative has signed quadratic numerator F=−r²+[g(m−4)−4]r+(g+1)[2g(m−1)−3]. For m=1 F<0, for m>=2 a positive root exists iff g>3/[2(m−1)], and then it is the unique global maximum (r*>0); otherwise F<0 all r>0. Direct root expansion r*_m=gm−2(g+1)+O_g(1/m) gives m rho_m(r*_m,g)→1/(2eg). Independent rational verification reproduced all stationary balances, regression ratios and derivative polynomial on several positive-rate/g parameter grids. Simulations are not used for infinite proof.
residual_risks: Stationarity and finite variance require r,g>0 and instantaneous independent Poisson resets; none of the conclusions extend automatically to non-Poisson or noisy bath-reset systems.
